about_the_game:
🥦 Brocco-Lee: “I’m not becoming a salad bowl! I’m blending in like a smoothie! 🥤💨”

🥕 Carrot-top: “Salad? Nah, I’m stir-fry material! Keep that leafy drama away from me! 🍳🔥”

🍅 Tommy Tomato: “Not me, bro! I’m turning into ketchup. No identity crisis here—just fries and vibes. 🍟😎”

🧅 Onion: “I cry at salads anyway. Count me OUT. 😭❌🥗”

🌟 "Only the crunchiest survive… but some just dodge the bowl altogether!" 😏🥊

🥦 Veggie Brawl is a super simple and funny party game for 2 to 10 players! 🎉

It’s all about having quick, silly fun — no complicated rules, just throwing vegetables 🥕🍅, slapping friends 🖐️🤣, and laughing a lot!

Play through 3 fast rounds of chaos, dodging flying food and trying to come out on top.

Perfect for game nights, parties, or just when you want to have a small dose of pure fun. 😄💥

Get in, throw some veggies, slap a friend, and laugh till you cry! 🧅😂

🥕 Why Play Veggie Brawl? 🥦
Multiplayer chaos has never been so crunchy!

Veggie Brawl is a fast-paced, multiplayer-only party game where up to 10 players jump into a hilarious food fight. The goal? Throw veggies, slap opponents, and be the last one standing in a wild garden showdown!

🌽 What Makes It Fun:

  • 👥 Multiplayer Mayhem – Only multiplayer, only madness. Play with friends or jump online and battle it out with up to 10 players in every match.

  • 🥔 Simple, Addictive Gameplay – No complicated rules—just throw, slap, and dodge! Easy to pick up, impossible to stop playing.

  • 😂 Endless Laughs – The chaos of flying veggies and unexpected slaps keeps the fun going every round.

  • 🍅 Perfect Party Game – Great for streaming, laughing with friends, or settling friendly rivalries.

No farming, no recipes—just pure veggie-fueled chaos. So grab your favorite produce and get ready to throw down in Veggie Brawl!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.5GHz or AMD Phenom 2.5GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or ATI Radeon HD 5850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.2GHz or AMD 4.0GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD R9 270X or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Veggie Brawl is a multiplayer game where 10 vegetables fight in 3 rounds. The last veggie standing wins, while the 9 losers turn into a salad! Each veggie has unique abilities, and players must strategize to survive. Only the strongest veggie avoids becoming a salad!
